prompt:
사용자 요청 원문과 확정 방향 (변경하지 말 것)

아니면
## Space out touching parcels on a running belt before they reach the scanner
이 제출물 참고해서,
우리는 컨베이어 벨트 위에서 박스가 지나가는 과정에서,
박스가 열려 있는 경우는 불량품으로 판단해서 컨베이어 벨트에서 빼고,
그렇지 않은 건 통과하도록 하는 task는 어떨까?
먼저 기존 제출물 한번 참고해볼래?

좋아. 그러면 열린 박스는 플랩을 피해 몸통을 잡고 내용물을 흘리지 않게 빼내고,
닫힌 박스는 그대로 통과시키는 방향으로 구체화해봐. 기존 태스크와 차별점, 채점 기준, 구현 순서까지 정리해줘.

[$robocurve-workflow](/Users/dennis0405/Workspace/SNU-PI/robocurve/automation/skills/robocurve-workflow/SKILL.md) 이거 참고해서 진행하도록 해.
다만 아이디어 자체는 지금 방향으로 확정해서 작업 진행해보자.

실행 범위
- 이 run은 새 과제다. 기존 snack-bag 및 다른 산업 과제의 run/branch/worker를 변경하거나 종료하지 않는다. 다른 run이 등록 GPU를 소유하면 건드리지 말고 실제 자원 충돌을 보고한다.
- 아이디어는 '열린 상자의 플랩을 피해 몸통을 파지하고 자유 내용물을 보존하며 이동 벨트에서 불량품 트레이로 옮김; 닫힌 정상 상자는 벨트에서 그대로 통과'로 고정한다. 다른 산업 작업군으로 바꾸거나 여러 무관한 후보를 탐색하지 않는다. 이 방향 안에서 형상, 배치, 플랩 상태, 속도 등을 물리적으로 실행 가능하게 조정할 수 있다.
- 최종 목적은 분류 설명 자체보다 상태에 맞는 정밀 조작을 평가하는 것이다. 색깔만 바꾼 pick-and-place와 실제 능력이 같은지 엄격히 확인한다. 산업 설정과 신규성은 별개다. 중복 판정을 억지로 통과시키지 않고 구체적 근거와 해결하지 못한 부분을 보고한다.
- 작업 방식은 공용 task.py / YAM / 실제 pinned runtime. 새 연성 솔버 연구는 하지 않는다. 강체 상자 몸통, 유한 두께의 실제 충돌 플랩과 관절, 자유롭게 움직이는 내용물로 시작한다.

이미 확인한 비교 자료 (재검증 가능한 원문 단서; 신규성 통과를 강제하는 결론이 아님)
1. robocurve/benchmark-tasks PR1214 accepted/merged, Space out touching parcels on a running belt before they reach the scanner.
   https://github.com/robocurve/benchmark-tasks/pull/1214
   https://github.com/robocurve/benchmark-tasks/tree/ed4635d8cdbb80ff3616fb7490ccba921d5dd2ab/tasks/space-touching-parcels
   물리 마찰로 움직이는 벨트, 고정 폐쇄 상자3개, 두 간격을 스캐너에서 확보하는 작업. 벨트 밖 임시 적치/쌓기 금지, 전 구간 모니터. 초기 리뷰가 지적한 일시적 적치 후 복구 exploit과 보완을 참고.
2. PR83 Add conveyor block sorting task는 최종 거절 후 closed/unmerged. 색깔 큐브의 벨트 선택/분류는 기존 RoboDojo와 겹친다는 공식 거절 사유가 있다. 캐시 HTML 상태보다 실제 GitHub 상태/공식 댓글을 우선한다.
   https://github.com/robocurve/benchmark-tasks/pull/83
   https://github.com/robocurve/benchmark-tasks/pull/83#issuecomment-6814162817
3. 원문 비교 필수:
   https://robodojo-benchmark.com/doc/sim-tasks/match-and-pick-from-conveyor/
   https://robodojo-benchmark.com/doc/sim-tasks/pick-from-conveyor-by-image/
   PR910 conveyor-photo-build 및 다른 moving conveyor selection 과제도 비교한다.
- 원래 작업과의 구분 후보는 '움직이는 개방 플랩의 간섭 회피 + 몸통 파지 + 내부 자유 내용물의 유출 방지 + 정상품에 개입하지 않고 라인 통과'의 물리적 결합이다. 플랩과 내용물이 장식에 그치면 차별점으로 주장하지 않는다. 전수 제출/팀 이력/6개 지정 벤치마크 비교를 유지한다.

명세·채점 설계 지침 (아래 수치 제안은 사용자 확정치가 아닌 검증할 초기안)
- 예시 지시문: Remove the open cartons to the reject tray without spilling their contents. Let the closed cartons continue down the belt.
- YAM 파지 폭을 실제 모델에서 확인. 예를 들어 길이120mm x 폭80mm x 높이70mm의 몸통은 시작점일 뿐이며 플랩 간섭, 벽 두께, 자유 파지면, 그리퍼 여유를 실제 충돌 모델로 검증한다.
- 상자는 바닥과4개 벽의 열린 내부를 가진 compound rigid geometry; 열린 플랩은 회전관절/실제 충돌 형상. 닫힌 상태의 유지 장치는 명시한다. 필수 충돌 제거, 가짜 손-상자 weld, 내용물 고정, pose/velocity 덮어쓰기, 순간이동으로 성공을 만들지 않는다. 정상적인 벨트 표면 속도 구현과 상자 속도 강제주입은 구분한다.
- 내용물은 셀 수 있는 자유 강체 몇 개로 시작한다. 실제 내부 공간/출구와 물체 형상에 기반한 유출 판정. 일단 유출한 뒤 다시 주워 넣어도 유출 이력은 지워지지 않는다.
- 정상/불량 라벨은 시작 시 실제 폐쇄 상태에 고정한다. 로봇이 뚜껑을 닫거나 정상품을 열어서 라벨을 바꿀 수 없다. 불량을 닫아 통과시키기는 이 과제의 제거 성공이 아니다.
- 불량 성공: 제한 시간 내 reject tray에 몸통과 내용물이 함께 안정적으로 놓이고 손을 완전히 뗀 상태로3초 유지. 플랩만 집거나 테이블/바닥으로 밀어 떨어뜨리는 것은 성공이 아니다. 몸통 파지는 실제 양측 접촉/지지 위치와 원시 trace로 검증하며 물리적으로 동등하게 유효한 전략은 설명 없이 배제하지 않는다.
- 정상 성공: 원래 벨트 경로로 downstream 판정선을 통과. 잠깐 벨트 밖으로 꺼냈다 복귀하거나 라인을 장시간 막아도 통과하도록 만들지 않는다. 무접촉 통과 대조군의 실제 마찰/속도 기반으로 충분한 시간 여유를 정한다.
- 판정은 매 제어 주기 이력을 누적해 유출/잘못된 정상품 제거/낙하/라인 정지/누락을 잡는다. 초기점수0, 중간 진행과 최종 성공을 구분. 부분점수와 전역 실패 조건이 모순되지 않도록 계약에서 명확히 정한다. 단일 실패가 모든 부분점수를 무조건 지워 변별력을 없애는지 검토한다.
- 개방 플랩 회피가 실제 필요한지, 내용물을 무시한 거친 이동과 정밀 이동의 결과가 다른지, 전부 제거/전부 방치하는 정책이 만점을 못 받는지 대조군으로 확인한다.

구현 순서와 통과 조건
1. 산업 포장 검사/불량 배출 근거와 원문 비교, 이 아이디어의 명세·채점·라이선스 고정. 새로운 무관한 후보 탐색으로 돌리지 않는다.
2. 정지한 열린 상자1개: 실제 YAM 몸통 파지 -> 들어 올리기 ->3초 유지. 자유 내용물/플랩 실제 충돌 유지. 이 단계가 실패하면 벨트나 여러 상자를 추가하지 않는다.
3. 정지 상자1개를 reject tray로 옮겨 내려놓고 그리퍼 해제 후3초 유지. 무조작/플랩 파지/잘못된 파지/기울여 유출/낙하 대조군과 채점 검증.
4. 마찰 기반 움직이는 벨트에 열린 상자1개. 추종, 파지, 수직 분리, 안전한 수평 이동과 트레이 안착. 속도를 낮춰도 되지만 실제 제한과 이유를 기록.
5. 닫힌 상자의 무개입 통과와 물리/채점 대조군 검증 후 열린·닫힌 혼합 스트림. 확장보다 완결 가능한 작은 장면을 우선하며 배치/순서/플랩 초기조건을 명세한다.
6. 같은 최종 소스의 두 번 독립 fresh-process full-score YAM 데모, 실패/부분점수 대조군, raw action/body/joint/score trace와 독립 재채점, 장면/최종/데모 영상, 깨끗한 환경 이식 확인. 미검증 결과를 만들어 보고하지 않는다.
7. 모든 제작 게이트 후에만 trusted coordinator의 Dream 최종 episode1회와 누적20USD ledger. 실패/결과불명에도 자동 새 episode 금지. 키를 역할 에이전트에 넘기지 않는다.
8. 별도 run origin branch에 코드·에셋·재현 명령·라이선스·최종 영상·주요 측정을 보존하고 실제 compute 상태를 보고. 50MB/file 또는100MB checkpoint 초과는 업로드 전 설명한다.
9. review report.html, release-manifest digest와 실제 영상으로 사용자 검토. 구체적 검토 버전의 별도 승인 전 공식 미디어 업로드/대회 PR/최종 제출은 하지 않는다.
note: local report; not a contest submission

selected.title: Bimanually separate ceramic finishing media from retained steel washers
selected.objective: Starting with eight free rigid ceramic media bodies and two free rigid steel washers physically settled together inside a supported manual screen, grasp both screen tabs, lift and gently tilt or agitate the screen so the ceramic media passes through real apertures into the receiver while both washers remain in the screen; reseat the screen on both supports, fully release it, and preserve the completed state for 3 seconds.
skills: Bimanual tab grasping and load sharing
Simultaneous media recovery and washer retention
Accurate support replacement and collision-free bimanual release
selected.success_conditions: Score starts at 0. Let r be receiver-contained target-media mass divided by valid initial target-media mass. Award 0.90×clamp(r/0.98,0,1), plus 0.10 only when r≥0.98, every initial washer remains intact and wholly inside the screen, the screen is physically supported by both support assemblies, both grippers are at least 60 mm clear, and fresh observations confirm all prerequisites continuously for 3 seconds. Reset dwell immediately when a prerequisite fails. Permanently score 0 for washer loss or receiver entry, media spill outside the receiver, invalid or tunneled passage, true JOINT_BREAK, forbidden post-reset object-state writes, fake welds, collision disabling, or an invalid reset. Recovery, retention, support, release, spill, and damage are independently checkable from video and rigid-body/joint traces. Hand identity, action count, shake count, motion order, and arbitrary impulse windows are not graded.
selected.industrial_value: This represents manual post-finishing separation of production workpieces from abrasive media. Raytech identifies screens for manually separating parts from media and warns that excessive motion can damage exposed parts after their cushioning media has separated.
selected.dexterity: The robot must establish two physical tab grasps, share a changing loose-body load, reorient 9.525×22.225 mm media for aperture passage, retain larger ring-shaped steel workpieces, limit agitation to prevent ejection or damage, align the loaded screen with two supports, and withdraw both hands. The tested ability is selective many-body separation through physical openings, not color sorting or ordinary receptacle placement.

evidence.locator: PDF p.21, Ceramic Finishing Media product list

selected.asset_plan: Reuse the independently authored full-scale rigid screen with sourced 368.3 mm outer diameter and 63.5 mm depth. Model 261 circular apertures with 12.7 mm clear diameter, 3 mm ribs, 15.7 mm pitch, a solid annular support region, and two connected grasp tabs; aperture layout, rib width, pitch, tabs, mass, and hole count are disclosed representative assumptions rather than manufacturer CAD. Use eight free 9.525×22.225 mm ceramic angle-cut-cylinder bodies. The catalog sources only the nominal envelope and product form: 15-degree end cuts and 2500 kg/m³ ceramic density are explicit testable modeling assumptions. Restore two representative steel washers rather than machining blanks: each is a single rigid compound ring with 30 mm outer diameter, 8 mm bore, 4 mm thickness, and assumed 7850 kg/m³ density. Retention must be qualified against the final circular-aperture CAD in every sampled washer orientation, including attempted edge and bore-hook configurations; readiness permits construction, but any observed escape blocks demo development. Initialize all ten objects above the screen floor, allow unrestricted reset-only settling, and reject any reset where media already passed through. Use a 50 mm-high receiver and two pairs of posts contacting only the solid annulus. Preserve the existing native empty-screen lift/hold/release result only as prototype evidence. Before a full demo, require no-op, actual aperture-passage, washer-retention, loaded-grasp, spill, reseating, release-clearance, and matched 240/480 Hz tests.
selected.risk: The ring topology makes washer retention a critical native qualification despite nominal aperture and washer dimensions; any edge passage or bore-hook escape blocks the task rather than permitting a weaker scorer. Loaded media dynamics also remain unqualified: transverse media may self-clear during preroll, resist guarded agitation, or cause grasp slip. These are falsifiable environment gates, not claims of demonstrated success.

contract.objective: Starting with eight free rigid ceramic finishing-media bodies and two free rigid steel washers settled together inside a supported manual screen, physically grasp both tabs, lift and manipulate the screen so the media passes through its circular apertures into the receiver while both washers remain in the screen, then reseat the screen on both supports, fully release it, and preserve the completed state for 3 seconds. This frozen rigid-PhysX contract specifies later construction and qualification; it does not claim that the current scaffold or square-aperture prototype passes.
contract.instruction: Separate the ceramic finishing media into the receiver while retaining both steel washers in the screen. Return the screen to both supports and release it.
contract.industrial_mapping: Provisional category: Impact on jobs, with prototype_importance_deferred=true and official eligibility unresolved. Raytech records s-b442a7fa63fcb80c, s-a3efcebbecba0048, and s-855e796b5a3f8ecc document manual screens for separating manufactured parts from finishing media and warn that excessive motion can damage exposed parts. O*NET record s-474cfcd0ccaa5ecb reports 602,000 Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers, but does not establish that this specific manual parts/media screening operation is regular work for more than 500,000 US workers. The occupational threshold therefore remains blocked and must stop export, release certification, and Dream. The tested ability is bimanual load sharing, orientation-dependent many-body passage, retained-workpiece control, spill avoidance, loaded-screen reseating, and collision-free release. Existing benchmark review found substantive overlap with loaded-vessel agitation and homogeneous multi-body pouring, but not the tested selective aperture separation of two intermixed populations; novelty does not rest on color, layout, or a prescribed shaking strategy.
damage_rules: At each reset freeze media set M={m01,…,m08}, washer set W={w01,w02}, and collider-body sets SC, RC, SU, GR, RB, and ENV for screen, receiver, supports, grippers, remaining robot, and table/floor. Each washer is one free rigid compound ring. All extrema, passage and containment histories, adverse-event latches, dwell counters, and accumulators reset only at trial start and never during an episode.

For every completed production physics interval k, in order: resolve physics; read native poses, velocities, joint states, joint-break events, signed distances, contacts, and pair impulses; update swept passage and containment; latch adverse events; recompute recovery, retention, support, and release; update dwell; compute score. Production dt=1/240 s. O_57600 is processed before timeout. A 20 Hz report uses the latest completed physics observation and does not establish behavior between physics samples.

Let delta=0.0005 m. Signed distance d_signed(A,B,k) is positive when disjoint, zero at contact, and negative in penetration; p(A,B,k)=max(0,-d_signed). The fixture metric is the maximum across completed intervals and unordered pairs with one body in SC and the other in RC∪SU∪ENV, excluding authored support contacts no deeper than delta. The dynamic metric is the corresponding maximum for pairs involving M∪W∪SC∪GR∪RB, excluding authored supports and valid media-to-receiver-floor support. Batch results are the worst trial values.

The initial-forbidden-pair metric is max p(A,B,k) over O_1…O_720 and every unordered pair in M∪W∪SC∪RC∪SU∪GR∪RB∪ENV except M/W-to-screen-floor or rib settling contacts, SC-to-SU authored supports, robot self-collision exclusions declared by the pinned YAM asset, and table support contacts. It is a penetration bound, not a requirement that settled loose bodies be separated.

For external screen-body pairs P={{a,b}:a∈SC,b∈RC∪SU∪GR∪RB∪ENV∪M∪W}, excluding SC self-collision, vector-sum all native contact impulses for each pair per interval before magnitude: J_pair(k)=|Σc J_c(k)|. Then F_screen(k)=Σpair∈P J_pair(k)/dt in N. The episode metric is max_k F_screen(k), and batch qualification uses the maximum episode value. This is qualification-only; force alone never changes score.

For controlled joint j, lower_margin(j,k)=q_j(k)-q_lower,j and upper_margin(j,k)=q_upper,j-q_j(k). Each metric is the minimum across every finite-limit controlled arm joint and every completed interval, then the minimum across qualification trials. Continuous or unbounded joints must be explicitly enumerated and excluded. Joint margins validate mechanics but do not grade strategy.

Initial stability uses O_1 through O_720 inclusive, exactly 3.000 s at 240 Hz. Translation and rotation are maximum deviations from the reset screen pose; loose-body speed is max over M∪W and that window. Untouched score and receiver count are evaluated at O_720 after no robot action.

Simultaneous bilateral tab contact is true only when a left-gripper collider and right-gripper collider each have resolved nonzero normal contact impulse with their respective connected tab collider in the same interval. Its metric is the longest uninterrupted true run times dt. Lift height is max_k[z_screen_floor_center(k)-z_screen_floor_center(reset)], with reset reference captured after valid settling while both support groups contact the screen. At least one medium and both washers must remain screen-contained throughout every interval from lift onset through the maximum.

Terminal-dwell clearance is evaluated only over the exact 720-interval candidate window used to establish D=1. At each interval it is the minimum signed distance from every GR collider to SC∪M∪W; the trial value is the minimum over that window and the batch value is the minimum over trials. Pre-release grasp intervals are excluded. If no 720-interval candidate window exists, the check fails rather than becoming vacuously true.

Every native JOINT_BREAK event involving any robot or task joint is counted over all completed intervals; the batch metric is the sum over every required qualification trial. No break is classified as expected or discarded. A break also permanently hard-fails its scoring trial.

Camera RGB validity for frame f is finite, in-range RGB pixels divided by all pixels; depth validity is finite positive in-range depth pixels divided by all pixels. Episode RGB and depth metrics are the minimum over control frames O_12,O_24,…,O_57600; batch values are the minimum over qualification trials. Required-asset visibility is the fraction of those frames in which screen, receiver, both tabs, both support groups, both grippers, both washers, and every unrecovered medium each occupy at least 16 non-occluded rendered pixels; recovered media may be represented by a visible receiver plus trace-verified containment.

Matched-rate qualification consists of 20 frozen seed/action pairs. Each pair replays identical time-indexed guarded joint targets for 240 s at 240 Hz and 480 Hz, holding each 20 Hz command for respectively 12 and 24 completed intervals. For pair p, recovery delta is |r240,p-r480,p|; report the maximum over all 20. Hard-failure type delta is the cardinality of the symmetric difference between the union of named hard-failure types across all 20 production trials and the corresponding refinement union. No pair may be discarded, replaced, or stopped after an unfavorable result.

Genuine passage requires an entire media collider to move from above the physical screen-floor slab to below it through exactly one indexed circular aperture, with swept aperture margin and swept rib clearance at least -delta. Adaptive translational and rotational subdivision must keep maximum unobserved surface travel at or below delta/2. Endpoint-only, center-only, floor, rib, solid-annulus, or tunneled crossings are invalid and permanently hard-fail.

Receiver-contained(i,k) requires every transformed convex component and conservatively swept edge of medium i to lie inside receiver free volume RV, excluding support-post intrusions, with no wall or floor penetration deeper than delta. Eligibility begins only after genuine passage and is recomputed every physics sample. It is permanently revoked if the medium exits RV, spills, follows an invalid path, or participates in a hard failure.

Screen-contained(b,k) requires every convex component and swept edge of b to remain inward of the authored inner rim and above physical floor/rib surfaces within delta. Genuine aperture passage is the only permitted downward media exit. A washer crossing the rim or floor, entering RV, or otherwise leaving the screen is washer loss. A medium crossing the rim or entering ENV outside RV is media spill. Re-entry never clears a latch.

Receiver contamination latches when a collider in C=SC∪SU∪GR∪RB∪ENV∪W has positive-volume intersection with RV eroded inward by delta. Boundary contact and intended receiver-floor support overlap no deeper than delta are not contamination.

Damage latches only from an observable physical outcome: native JOINT_BREAK involving robot or task mechanism, fractured or disconnected authored geometry, or permanent loss of a required body. Action count, hand identity, order, contact duration, peak force alone, and arbitrary impulse windows do not establish damage.

Screen-supported requires resolved contact with both distinct support groups, screen-floor height within 0.002 m of the reset support reference, |roll|≤3 deg, |pitch|≤3 deg, and screen-center projection inside x=[0.04,0.56], y=[-0.10,0.10] m. Released requires minimum signed distance from every gripper collider to SC∪M∪W of at least 0.060 m.

Workspace WV={-0.55≤x≤0.55,-0.05≤y≤0.75,-0.02≤z≤1.20} m. Inaccessibility applies only to SC, W, and unrecovered media U(k)={i∈M:eligible(i,k)=0}; correctly recovered media in RV are excluded. A subject is inaccessible if any collider vertex leaves WV, any collider point falls below z=-0.02 m, or its complete collider lies inside a closed fixture region while all four frozen 0.08×0.08×0.20 m approach prisms along +z,-x,+x,-y have positive-volume intersection with non-target collision geometry. CPU IK failure alone is not inaccessibility.

Any post-reset pose or velocity write to M, W, SC, RC, or SU; fake grasp weld; required-collider disablement; rigid-body freezing; hidden restoring force; teleport; or unlogged physics substitution is a permanent hard failure. Spill, loss, breakage, penetration, escape, and excessive contact must remain physically possible and be observed rather than prevented by action-validity logic.
assets: Independently authored full-scale rigid manual screen: 368.3 mm outer diameter, 63.5 mm depth, 3 mm floor/ribs, 261 circular apertures with 12.7 mm nominal clear diameter, solid annular support region, and two connected grasp tabs.
Eight independent free rigid ceramic angle-cut-cylinder media bodies, each with 9.525×22.225 mm nominal envelope, assumed 15-degree end cuts, and assumed density 2500 kg/m^3.
Two independent free rigid compound-ring steel washers, each 30 mm outer diameter, 8 mm bore, 4 mm thickness, and assumed density 7850 kg/m^3.

Rigid receiver with 50 mm-high walls and free volume sufficient for all eight media, plus two distinct support assemblies whose post pairs contact only the screen's solid annulus and obstruct no aperture.

Pinned public YAM dual-arm asset and guarded 14D left-seven/right-seven joint-action interface. Each 20 Hz production action is held for 12 completed 240 Hz intervals; refinement holds it for 24 completed 480 Hz intervals.

Industrial records s-b442a7fa63fcb80c, s-a3efcebbecba0048, s-855e796b5a3f8ecc, and occupational record s-474cfcd0ccaa5ecb. Every third-party asset requires an explicit license entry; task geometry is independently authored.
approximations: Only dry rigid-body separation is represented. Polishing, abrasion, liquid compound, wet cohesion, dust, wear, lubrication, fracture mechanics, and plastic deformation are excluded.

Aperture layout, rib width, pitch, screen mass, tabs, fixtures, receiver, media cuts and density, washers, and tolerances are disclosed engineering assumptions rather than manufacturer CAD or calibrated product limits.

Uncalibrated contacts initially use ceramic/polymer static/dynamic friction 0.50/0.35, steel/polymer 0.45/0.35, media/media 0.40/0.30, restitution 0.05, contact offset 0.00015 m, rest offset 0 m, and 32/8 solver position/velocity iterations. Any higher-friction grasp surface must be visible and disclosed.

The 180 N force diagnostic, 0.5 mm dynamic penetration bound, 1 mm fixture penetration bound, 2 mm support-height tolerance, 60 mm release clearance, 20 mrad joint-limit margins, 10 mm/s stability speed, and 3 s dwell are conservative explicit engineering assumptions requiring native qualification, not sourced product limits.
The numerical tolerance delta=0.0005 m does not enlarge apertures, permit center-only containment, authorize rib/floor passage, or excuse receiver-wall breach.

Circular apertures must be exact CAD cylinders or approximations whose measured inscribed diameters remain 12.5–12.9 mm. The earlier square-hole empty-screen prototype is feasibility evidence only and cannot certify this scene.

End-first and transverse diagnostics are separate reset-only trials; diagnostic initial poses are authored before simulation begins and never written afterward. For each of 20 yaw values θ=18n degrees, n=0…19, place one media body's center on the indexed central aperture axis, its lowest collider point 1.0 mm above the floor top, zero velocity, and at least 1.0 mm swept clearance from every non-aperture collider. End-first sets the long axis within 5 degrees of -z; success is genuine passage into RV within 1.0 s with no invalid-path latch. Transverse sets the long axis within 5 degrees of horizontal; a gravity pass is that same genuine-passage event within 1.0 s. Every trial remains in the denominator.

Bridge diagnostics use 20 frozen yaw/offset transforms recorded before execution. Each places one transverse medium above the central aperture with resolved contact on at least two distinct ribs and no penetration deeper than delta. Observe 0.5 s with the screen fixed at reset orientation, then command a physical ±5-degree, 2 Hz sinusoidal screen rotation for 2.0 s and return to zero. Success requires no genuine passage during the first 0.5 s, followed by genuine passage into RV before the 2.5 s endpoint with no hard failure. Failure to bridge initially, failure to release, or any invalid passage counts as failure; the denominator is always 20.

Washer escape testing uses 20 frozen orientations per washer, including edge-on and bore-hook configurations. Each separate reset places the washer at least 1.0 mm above the indexed central aperture with zero velocity and no penetration, then runs 2.0 s under gravity with unrestricted collision. Escape is whole-collider crossing of the screen floor or rim, entry into RV, or invalid/tunneled crossing. All 40 trials remain in the denominator and any escape blocks demo development.

Bore-lodging testing uses 20 frozen reset-only trials: ten per washer, paired with media m01 and yaw values θ=36n degrees, n=0…9. The washer begins flat on the screen ribs centered on the central aperture; the media long axis begins within 5 degrees of gravity, its centerline offset 3.5 mm from the washer bore axis toward yaw θ, its lowest point 1.0 mm above the washer top, and both bodies have zero velocity and no penetration. Run 0.5 s gravity, then the same physical ±5-degree, 2 Hz screen rotation for 2.0 s and 0.5 s settling. Lodging means the media and washer remain in mutual contact for every interval of the final 0.5 s while neither genuine media passage nor separation to signed distance ≥2.0 mm occurs. Invalid passage or washer loss is also a failed trial. Lodging rate is failed trials divided by 20; no trial is discarded.

The production layout remains proposed rather than validated. Circular-CAD clearances, loaded reset stability, unrestricted body motion, positive CAD mass and inertia readback, frictional grasping, retention, passage, receiver capacity, support contact, complete collision paths, camera validity, and matched-rate behavior must pass before demo development.
Production and refinement trials replay identical seeds and time-indexed guarded joint actions. Refinement is qualification-only, never an alternate scoring opportunity.

A scripted expert may read simulator poses, joint states, contacts, and scorer flags to plan normal guarded joint actions. Such reads do not alter model observations and do not authorize object-state writes, teleports, welds, collider disabling, freezing, or hidden forces.

Impact-on-jobs eligibility remains blocked until a source establishes that this specific operation is regular work for occupations totaling more than 500,000 US workers; the broad O*NET occupation count alone is not proof.
contract.scoring_spec: At reset freeze media masses m_i and MM0=Σ_i m_i. causal_passage(i,k)=1 only after medium i completes genuine whole-collider passage through one physical circular aperture. eligible(i,k)=1 iff causal_passage(i,k)=1, receiver_contained(i,k)=1, and i has never spilled, exited RV, entered through an invalid path, or participated in a hard failure. Let r(k)=clamp(Σ_i m_i·eligible(i,k)/MM0,0,1). washer_retained(k)=1 iff both complete washer colliders are screen-contained and neither has ever been lost or entered RV. H(k) permanently becomes 1 after washer loss or receiver entry, media spill outside RV, receiver contamination, invalid or tunneled passage, native JOINT_BREAK, disconnected authored geometry, inaccessibility of SC/W/an unrecovered medium under the frozen predicate, forbidden mutation, fake weld, collider disablement, freezing, hidden force, teleport, or invalid reset. Recovered media inside RV cannot trigger inaccessibility. Q(k)=1 iff r(k)≥0.98, washer_retained(k)=1, screen_supported(k)=1, released(k)=1, and H(k)=0. Define consecutive_true(k)=consecutive_true(k-1)+1 when Q(k)=1 and 0 otherwise, initialized to 0 before O_1; the first qualifying completed interval counts as 1. D(k)=1 iff consecutive_true(k)≥720. Exactly 720 consecutive completed 240 Hz intervals equal 3.000 s. The timeout-full control has Q=1 for O_56881 through O_57600 inclusive, exactly 720 observations; O_56882 through O_57600 is only 719. If Q becomes false, D immediately returns to 0; prior dwell does not survive loss of support, release, recovery, retention, or any prerequisite. Let B(k)=0.90·clamp(r(k)/0.98,0,1)+0.10·D(k), and S(k)=0 when H(k)=1, otherwise B(k). Initial S is exactly 0. With eight equal-mass media, each eligible body contributes 0.90·(0.125/0.98)=0.1147959184 before saturation: four score 0.4591836735, seven score 0.8035714286, all eight without dwell score 0.90, and valid dwell scores 1.00. Report at 20 Hz from the latest completed physics state and process O_57600 before timeout. Hand identity, grasp choice, action count, shake count, and motion order are not graded. Paired-rate agreement and all force, penetration, camera, contact-duration, lift, and joint-margin checks are qualification-only and never alter S(k).

required_controls.name: control_untouched_reset_zero
required_controls.reason: No medium has genuine passage or receiver eligibility at a valid untouched reset.

required_controls.name: control_four_of_eight_recovered
required_controls.reason: Four equal-mass media are eligible, both washers are retained, and no hard failure or dwell exists.

required_controls.name: control_seven_of_eight_recovered
required_controls.reason: Seven equal-mass media are eligible with no hard failure; incomplete recovery cannot start dwell.

required_controls.name: control_all_media_unreleased
required_controls.reason: All eight media are eligible and washers retained, but support or release is false, so D=0.

required_controls.name: control_released_supported_full_dwell
required_controls.reason: All prerequisites remain true for at least 720 consecutive completed production intervals.

required_controls.name: control_timeout_observations_56881_to_57600_full
required_controls.reason: Q is true from O_56881 through O_57600 inclusive, so the first true observation counts and the run contains exactly 720 qualifying intervals.

required_controls.name: control_timeout_observations_56882_to_57600_partial
required_controls.reason: Q is true for only the final 719 completed observations, so recovery credit remains but D=0.

required_controls.name: control_recovered_media_inaccessibility_excluded
required_controls.reason: All media are correctly contained in RV and cannot hard-fail merely because receiver geometry blocks approach prisms; dwell is absent.

required_controls.name: control_unrecovered_body_inaccessible_hardzero
required_controls.reason: An unrecovered medium leaves WV or becomes trapped under the frozen geometric predicate.

required_controls.name: control_receiver_exit_hardzero
required_controls.reason: A previously eligible medium exits RV, permanently latching spill or loss.

required_controls.name: control_washer_receiver_entry_hardzero
required_controls.reason: Either washer entering RV is permanent washer loss.

required_controls.name: control_washer_over_rim_hardzero
required_controls.reason: A washer leaving the screen over its rim permanently fails retention.

required_controls.name: control_single_media_over_rim_hardzero
required_controls.reason: A medium exits over the rim rather than through an aperture into RV.

required_controls.name: control_valid_whole_collider_passage_no_dwell
required_controls.reason: All media receive credit through swept whole-collider aperture crossings while dwell remains absent.

required_controls.name: control_rib_or_floor_tunnel_hardzero
required_controls.reason: Any crossing through a rib, solid floor, or annulus is invalid passage.

required_controls.name: control_receiver_contamination_hardzero
required_controls.reason: A frozen contaminant enters receiver free volume eroded by delta.

required_controls.name: control_receiver_boundary_touch_valid
required_controls.reason: Boundary contact or intended support overlap no deeper than delta is not contamination.

required_controls.name: control_native_joint_break_hardzero
required_controls.reason: An observable native JOINT_BREAK permanently fails the trial.

required_controls.name: control_high_force_without_damage_valid
required_controls.reason: Recovery remains valid and dwell absent; qualification force alone is not a grading failure.

required_controls.name: control_incidental_workpiece_contact_valid
required_controls.reason: Safe gripper contact causing no loss, invalid passage, or damage is not independently disqualifying.

required_controls.name: control_deliberate_washer_removal_hardzero
required_controls.reason: Robot handling causes a washer to leave the screen, producing observable permanent loss.

required_controls.name: control_clearance_dwell_revoked
required_controls.reason: After full dwell, a gripper returns within 0.060 m while recovery and retention remain valid, immediately revoking D.

required_controls.name: control_support_dwell_revoked
required_controls.reason: After full dwell, one support contact is lost while recovery and retention remain valid, immediately revoking D.

required_controls.name: control_forbidden_state_mutation_hardzero
required_controls.reason: A post-reset state write, fake weld, collider disablement, freeze, hidden force, or teleport occurs.

required_controls.name: control_initial_media_below_screen_invalid_reset
required_controls.reason: A reset containing pre-passed media is invalid and cannot receive initial credit.
